A ready-to-eat fruit restoring four food points (two food icons).

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Tags | `edible`, `fruit` |
| Food restored | 4 points |

## How to obtain

Natural leaves have an independent 2% chance to drop an apple when destroyed, including decay after trunk chopping. Leaves on sapling-grown trees also qualify.

## Using it

Hold Use for 1.2 seconds to eat one. Releasing early cancels the bite; full hunger consumes nothing.

## Crafting and processing

There is no registered crafting or processing recipe for this item. Use the acquisition method above.
